theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: A theme changes the whole interface: layout, navigation, cards and player.

colorScheme.label: Color scheme
colorScheme.onlyOne: This theme comes in one color scheme only.

motion.label: Motion
motion.hint: “Reduced” turns off parallax, automatic carousels and trailer previews.

trailerAutoplay.label: Play trailers automatically
trailerAutoplay.hint: Starts muted in the large area at the top when you stay there for a moment.

uiSounds.label: Interface sounds
uiSounds.hint: Quiet signals when the focus moves and when you select something.

language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Titles and descriptions come in the language set on the server.

deviceMode.label: Control mode
deviceMode.hint: TV: larger text and focus frames, operated with the remote control.

overscan.label: Screen margin for TVs
overscan.hint: Some TVs cut off the edges of the picture. Increase the value until everything is visible.
